title: [ObjectDB Profiler] Improve filter options and make easier to identified what changed when making a diff

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
- Entries in the list will show colors to represent Added, Removed, Modified
- Added a toolbar to filter Added, Removed, Modified, Unmodified objects, with Unmodified unchecked by default
- Filter textbar now supports filtering in the form 'column_title:match'

- **Depends on #123619**

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

When comparing snapshots is hard to find specific objects, and also know at first glance if an object was added, removed, or modified.
This makes this distinction quite easily
Upcomming PR will improve the visualization of Inbound/Outbound references, and also add a list of modified properties when making a diff between snapshots

### Known issue

Clicking in the inbound/outbound list an object that was hidden by the diff-status filter does nothing.
I'm not sure what to do about it. Should show some warning? Make all objects visible? Make all visible if the user double clicks? I'm open to suggestions
